# isaac-mcp

A general-purpose NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab simulation server via MCP.

## Tools
- load_scene / list_scenes — scene depot management
- spawn_model — add USD/URDF models to scenes
- start_sim / stop_sim / list_jobs — simulation lifecycle
- get_state / apply_control — sim state and control
- sim_status — health check (GPU, Isaac availability)
- agentic_sim_workflow — multi-step AI orchestration
- natural_language_control — NL to actuator commands
- analyze_sim_state / analyze_sim_logs — AI analysis
- discover_model — AI-powered USD/URDF model discovery

## Setup
```powershell
uv run python -m isaac_mcp
```

## Docs
- docs/ISAAC_VS_OTHERS.md — Isaac vs MuJoCo vs Gazebo comparison
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — subprocess model, IPC design
